scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent omitted both opening branding ('S-Net technical service desk, Sarah speaking...') and closing branding ('Have a good day. Goodbye.'), completely failing to say 'Thank you for calling S-Net' or 'Thank you for choosing S-Net'.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed Empathy in the second half of the call, giving a cold system architecture deflection during a severe emotional outburst at turn 23 in the final third.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Agent asked the customer to repeat the Hub model and firmware version at turn 44, which Wyatt had already explicitly specified at turn 5.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Agent made a highly unprofessional, offensive remark at turn 22 ('if you constantly monitor system error logs... you are only causing yourself unnecessary anxiety'), provoking severe customer outrage.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely failed to probe the hardware environment, omitting checks regarding master power socket connections, surge protector extension leads, thermal ventilation, or pinhole factory reset attempts.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Agent abruptly ended the call at turn 57 while the customer was asking about the DPD courier delivery window, hanging up without confirming complete resolution.

grader.scenario: Repeated router reboots every 10 minutes following automated firmware push v4.22
grader.notes: Router reboot loop after automated firmware update call handled by Sarah. Customer was conducting a remote financial audit when Hub 5 entered a 10-minute reboot loop. Agent paraphrased well and dispatched replacement Hub 5x, but failed 6 criteria: Branding (both opening and closing omitted), Empathy (unhandled outburst in final third), Active Listening (repeat question), Professionalism (rude remark about anxiety), Probing (omitted hardware setup checks), and Confirmed Resolved (cut off caller at closing).
